shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone face
possible figural/animal forms rendered in shallow relief
carving extending horizontally along a wall-like surface
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carving spread horizontally across a built or blocky stone face, and B seems to preserve faint curved forms that could be figures or animals, which is the only correspondence and a very generic one. A shows a clearly legible, highly conventionalised procession of profile human figures in identical dress carrying vessels, a large profile animal head, and a precise band of rosettes above a register line, whereas B offers no recognisable repeated motif, no register system and no identifiable posture or attribute to match.
